caption:
756 MW: Integra has filed an application for an $8bn data center project near Childress, Texas.

Also on 10 Nov: SoftBank, Grab and PETROS set a long-term target of 5 GW or more in Malaysia, starting with US$1.85 billion in seed capital. A 480MW plan in Kazakhstan was announced, and Deutsche Telekom will add 20MW to its Munich AI site.

Filings, targets and plans are not capacity. Our pipeline shows Malaysia at 1492 MW under construction and 1642 MW announced.

Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 11 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
